# Vendored libraries

- `minisearch.js` — [MiniSearch](https://github.com/lucaong/minisearch) v7.2.0, MIT © Luca Ongaro. ES module build from npm, vendored so the site has zero external requests.
- `98/` — [98.css](https://github.com/jdan/98.css) v0.1.20, MIT © Jordan Scales, with its Pixelated MS Sans Serif webfonts. Loaded only when the Win98 theme is active.
- `../icons/` — category icons from [win98icons.alexmeub.com](https://win98icons.alexmeub.com) (Alex's own collection of original Windows 98 icons).
